key_compatibility: identical key set to CORRECTED-C v1 and to Job 3; inherited from the unconfirmed job2/job3 chain and not re-derived or endorsed here

columns.evaluable_n: sum of the four RECIST cells (CR+PR+SD+PD) for this results group; Job 3's selection rule, reproduced unchanged
columns.arm_set_type_state: NO_ARMS_REGISTERED_IN_THIS_CACHE | ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | PARTIALLY_TYPED_IN_THIS_CACHE | ALL_ARMS_NON_CONTROL_TYPED | ALL_ARMS_CONTROL_TYPED | MIXED_ARM_TYPES
columns.arm_link_state: SOURCE_CONFIRMED | LABEL_MATCH | PROPOSED | UNRESOLVED | CONTESTED | UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE
columns.arm_link_relation: the exact relation that produced the state; TWO_INDEPENDENT_FIELD_IDENTITIES:<a>+<b>, DESCRIPTION_FIELD_IDENTITY:<a>, LABEL_IDENTITY_ONLY:<a>, LABEL_*_AMBIGUOUS, LEAF_CLAIM_*, CONTRARY_DESCRIPTION:<prior>, NO_*
columns.arm_link_source_locator: exact field path(s) compared, and for a retained leaf claim the leaf file and line
columns.n_candidate_arms: EXACT number of compatible registered arms; an arm is bound only when this is 1
columns.candidate_arm_indices: pipe-joined armGroups indices, all preserved when ambiguous
columns.bound_arm_index: armGroups index, non-empty only for SOURCE_CONFIRMED or LABEL_MATCH
columns.bound_arm_registered_type_verbatim: armGroups[bound].type verbatim (registration, NOT a clinical role)
columns.comparator_role: CLINICAL role: COMPARATOR_SUPPORTED_BY_SOURCE_CONFIRMED_ARM_TYPE | COMPARATOR_PROPOSED_BY_LABEL_MATCHED_ARM_TYPE | COMPARATOR_PROPOSED_BY_GROUP_TEXT_{PLACEBO,NO_INTERVENTION,UNSPECIFIED} | CONTESTED | NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_THIS_CACHE | UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE. NOT_ESTABLISHED means no comparator evidence exists in this cache; it is NEVER a claim that the group had no comparator role.
columns.comparator_role_basis: prose basis naming the fields used
columns.registry_type_statement: REGISTRATION statement, distinct from comparator_role: BOUND_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPE_IS_<type> | BOUND_ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | ALL_REGISTERED_ARMS_{NON_,}COMPARATOR_TYPED_CONDITIONAL | ARM_TYPE_ABSENT_IN_THIS_CACHE | ARM_SET_TYPE_NOT_UNIFORM_NO_TYPE_STATEMENT_POSSIBLE | NO_ARMS_REGISTERED_IN_THIS_CACHE
columns.registry_type_statement_assumption: machine-readable assumption a *_CONDITIONAL or LABEL_MATCH statement rests on; empty only when the statement is unconditional
columns.leaf_claim_state: NO_LEAF | LEAF_CLAIMS_NO_ARM | LEAF_LABEL_RESOLVES_UNIQUELY | LEAF_LABEL_NOT_UNIQUE_IN_RECORD | LEAF_LABEL_ABSENT_FROM_RECORD | LEAF_CLAIMS_MULTIPLE_ARMS
columns.leaf_narrative_verbatim_not_parsed: the leaf's free-text evidence field, carried verbatim for human reading; NO expression in the producer tests it (this is what v1's token predicate did)
columns.sole_arm_multi_results_group_flag: YES when one registered arm faces several results groups
columns.v1_arm_link_state: prior-state index from CORRECTED-C v1, read-only

normalisation: case and whitespace only. Punctuation, hyphens, brackets, dosage units and spelling are NOT normalised.
